title: Zindan may sakina ko
body:
zindan may sakina ko yaad aaya wo seena
jis seena pe soti thi masoom sakina
<<DIVIDER>>
kar taras zara zaalim baba ko na roungi
mai godh may madar ki aaram se soungi
be-rehm layeeno ne faryad suni na
zindan may sakina ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai maut ki khamoshi tareeki e zindan may
kya jurm kiya logon masoom si mehman ne
koi aur to masooma yun qaid hui na
zindan may sakina ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
har waqt chamakta tha karbal may madine may
taweez ki maanind tha shabbir ke seene may
gum hogaya wo kaise zindan may nagina
zindan may sakina ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
phat jaye na ghairat se sajjad jigar tera
mere ghar ki ye raunaq hai kehta hai pidar tera
ye soch ke abid ko kuch hosh rahi na
zindan may sakina ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
rukhsaar mai nana ko mehshar may dikhaungi
roodad mai zindan ki ro ro ke sunaungi
pabandi hai rone pe kehta hai kameena
zindan may sakina ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay dashte ajal ruk ja beemar ko aane de
baba ke liye koi paigham sunane de
shayad meri turbat pe wo aaye kabhi na
zindan may sakina ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye maut bhi hairaan thi masoom ki mayyat pe
afsos rahi karti ahmed ki raiyyat pe
tha maut ke chehre pe ghairat ka pasina
zindan may sakina ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
sardar sakina ko zindan may dafan kar ke
sajjad ye kehte thay na kafn mila mar ke
ta hashr rulayegi teri maut sakina
zindan may sakina ko...
author: Yusuf Sardar
